extDescription.message: Hands browser downloads to the PGet multi-connection download manager on your computer. Open source, no tracking, local only.

menuDownloadPageVideo.message: Download video on this page with PGet

notifyPairBody.message: This download was left to the browser. Click to open settings and pair again.

notifyNotRunningBody.message: PGet doesn't seem to be running. Start it and try again; where possible the browser is downloading it instead.

notifyErrorBody.message: Something went wrong talking to PGet; where possible the browser is downloading it instead.

notifyUnsupportedBody.message: PGet can't handle this link (only http, https and magnet are supported).

statusNotRunningHint.message: Start the PGet desktop app and it will connect automatically. Until then the browser handles downloads as usual.

statusNotPairedHint.message: Click Pair, then allow it in the PGet window. Downloads will be handed to PGet after that.

popupPauseHint.message: When on, the browser keeps all downloads

pairWaitingHint.message: Click Allow in the PGet window (within 60 seconds).

pairDenied.message: PGet denied the request, or it timed out.

pairFailed.message: Pairing failed. Make sure PGet is running and try again.

optForgetConfirm.message: Forget the pairing? Downloads will stay in the browser until you pair again.

optPauseDesc.message: While on, no downloads are intercepted. The right-click menu still works.

optMinSizeDesc.message: Files smaller than this (when the size is known) stay in the browser. 0 intercepts everything.

optExcludedDesc.message: Downloads from these sites (and their subdomains) always stay in the browser.

optInvalidSite.message: That doesn't look like a site. Enter a domain such as example.com.

optNotifyDesc.message: The ✓ badge on the toolbar icon is always shown. Errors and pairing prompts are not affected.

optPrivacyNote.message: The PGet extension only talks to PGet on this computer (127.0.0.1). It never sends data to external servers and has no analytics or tracking.
